Two pronunciation fixes found while making the softmax-fix paper video (arXiv 2610.31642).

| Written | Spoken (lexicon) | Before (Whisper heard) | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| expm1 | exp m 1 | X1 (letters run together) | EXP M 1 |
| epsilon | ep-silon | Excelon (OK~) | EP Silent (closer to ep-si-lon) |

Captions keep the written forms; only the voice reads the respelling. Evidence rows added to `references/pronunciation.md`.
